Hi Priya,

Thanks for sending these over. NovusHealth uses SAP Ariba for supplier onboarding and we do require an Ariba Supplier ID before we issue POs for software vendors. Please start supplier registration here: https://supplier.ariba.com/registration/novus-ABC-12345.

Key notes for your team:
- Please complete the "Remit/Payee" section and upload a W-9 (US) or W-8BEN (if applicable).
- Our AP team requires a separate PO routing contact (name + email) — fields are on the Ariba form.
- We support EDI 850 (PO) and 810 (invoice) but it is not mandatory for first POs; AP will accept emailed invoices for initial engagement.

I've attached our internal supplier enablement checklist for reference. Once you submit in Ariba, share the Supplier ID and we'll mark you as "enabled" for Purchase Orders. Legal typically wants to see the Ariba vendor record before executing the Order Form, but can start redline review in parallel.
